title: Prisma + Supabase + Vercel: PostgreSQL Prepared Statement Error Fix

problemSummary.description: Multiple Prisma client instances in serverless functions create conflicting prepared statements
symptoms: Error: prepared statement 's1', 's2', etc. already exists
500 errors on API endpoints using Prisma
affectedEndpoints: Any API route using Prisma client

rootCauseAnalysis.primaryCause: Multiple PrismaClient instances in serverless environment

technicalExplanation.issue: Each serverless function execution creates a new PrismaClient instance
technicalExplanation.conflict: Multiple instances attempt to create prepared statements with identical names
technicalExplanation.postgresqlBehavior: PostgreSQL prevents duplicate prepared statement names within same session
technicalExplanation.connectionPooling: Supabase pooler reuses connections, causing prepared statement name collisions

contributingFactors: Concurrent API requests creating multiple Prisma instances

immediateActions.priority: URGENT - Implement immediately to restore service

steps.description: Implement global PrismaClient instance to prevent multiple instantiations
Replace direct PrismaClient imports with singleton import
Run npx prisma generate to ensure clean client state
Push changes to Vercel to resolve active errors

1_prismaSingleton.title: Implement Prisma Client Singleton Pattern
1_prismaSingleton.description: Create a single, globally accessible PrismaClient instance

implementation.explanation: Uses globalThis to ensure single instance across hot reloads and function executions

benefits: Reduces memory usage in serverless functions
